verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own business filing page (coloradosos.gov/biz/FileDoc.do) lists filing paths for forming LLCs, profit and nonprofit corporations, partnerships, and foreign entities, plus name reservation. The business main page links to periodic report filing and trade name renewal, which shows the core formation and filing transactions are offered through its web filing system. missing for 10: explicit page text stating filings are completed and paid entirely online, end-to-end walkthrough or fee-payment evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed online filing.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
